<?xml version="1.0"?>
<resources xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools" tools:locale="de_DE">
  <!-- Directory qualifiers, not this design-time annotation, own the locale. -->
  <string name=" anchor.route ">North harbor anchor</string>
  <string name="route" product=" default ">Default night passage</string>
  <string name="route" product=" tablet ">Tablet night passage</string>
  <item type="string" name="beacon">Night beacon</item>
  <string-array name="lanes">
    <item><![CDATA[North <safe> & clear]]></item>
    <item>@string/anchor.route</item>
    <item>South night lane</item>
  </string-array>
  <plurals name="signals">
    <item quantity="one">%1$d quiet signal</item>
    <item quantity="other">%1$d quiet signals</item>
  </plurals>
  <string translatable="false" name="private">Keep private night note</string>
</resources>
